name: Smarter AI
description: AI empires only (never the player or pirates): an optimised research order for the three research trees, re-weighed yearly for threats and reach, and growth taxes (colonies below a share of their maximum population pay no tax unless the treasury needs them). Set on the new-game wizard's Other Empires page.

flags.name: smarterAIResearch
flags.label: Optimised research order
flags.description: AI empires research the three trees in an optimised order (shields and damage control earlier under threat, fuel-efficient hyperdrives earlier for spread-out or sparse empires).

flags.name: smarterAIGrowthTax
flags.label: Growth taxes
flags.description: AI colonies below the threshold share of their maximum population pay no tax; in debt the fullest colonies are taxed first until the shortfall is covered.

flags.name: smarterAIBudget
flags.label: Cut costs when broke
flags.description: In debt, AI empires scrap their oldest obsolete state ships and bases (never a threatened colony's defenders) and skip low-value builds; with a large surplus they build more colony ships, defences and research stations and spend more readily on wonders.

flags.name: smarterAIRetrofit
flags.label: Keep fleets up to date
flags.description: When money allows, AI empires retrofit their obsolete warships away from the front, worst first, a few at a time.

flags.name: smarterAIDefence
flags.label: Defence that counts pirates
flags.description: AI empires weigh the known pirate bases and visible hostile ships near their colonies: more warships per colony under threat, and defensive bases at threatened colonies.

flags.name: smarterAIPirates
flags.label: Pirate clean-up
flags.description: AI empires always hunt pirate bases near their colonies (also at war), attack several at once, form strike fleets from idle warships, and send troops against pirate facilities on their planets.

flags.name: smarterAIResearchStations
flags.label: Smarter research stations
flags.description: AI empires build one research station per field at the best bonus location known, move their best scientists there, and build no plain stations at their research cap.

flags.name: smarterAIWonders
flags.label: Pursue wonders
flags.description: AI empires pick a wonder that fits them (research and economy when peaceful, military when aggressive), research towards it and build it when affordable.

flags.name: smarterAIEspionage
flags.label: Use spies well
flags.description: AI agents steal rivals' technology and sabotage pirate bases near their colonies; counter-intelligence rises while hostile agents are active.

flags.name: smarterAIDiplomacy
flags.label: Diplomacy with purpose
flags.description: AI empires seek trade and defence treaties with empires facing the same threat (pirates or a runaway empire) and pay pirate protection when it is cheaper than the expected losses.

params.name: smarterAIGrowthTaxThreshold
params.label: Growth taxes: untaxed below this % of maximum population
